name: tjo-claude-plugins
description: Truls Johnsen's personal Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: explainer
plugins.description: Pick the clearest explanation format (prose, diagram, interactive page, video), and make narrated 3Blue1Brown-style explainer videos with automatic dependency setup.

plugins.name: comments
plugins.description: Audit code comments against a 10-class rubric and report each finding with its class and a suggested fix, grouped by fix size; adopt the rubric as a repo's coding standard for comments, so code reviews enforce it.
